commenti.body: From the little research I did I can see that maybe archive has faced some challenges in the EU (same with the USA, tbh) but I hope this link helps.  I haven't seen a lot of WIseman but I love Titticut Follies and The Store, had never heard of this one before, so thanks for the rec.

*Belfast Maine* has been edited in DVD in France (Blaq Out editions), along with his other films which were all edited together in three big DVDboxsets. You can still buy them on many website online (amazon etc.).

https://ww1.m4uhd.tv/search/frederick-wiseman.html
